description: Stable compile finding codes. ERROR findings stop compilation (no document); WARNING findings accompany a compiled document. `rule` is the compact text the repair prompt shows for a line.

codes.rule: The document contains no block.
The source is larger than 256 KiB, or the compiled document is rejected by a NativeDocumentReader size limit (1 MiB, 10,000 nodes, depth 32).
Headings are # to ### only; split the topic or use a paragraph.
Lists are one level; write nested items as separate paragraphs or a table.
Fenced code blocks are not part of MBM v1; use inline code or describe the code in prose (code_block is planned in #303).
Every opening fence needs a closing fence on its own line.
A link label cannot contain another link.
Only ::table, ::mermaid, ::audio, ::image, ::video and ::sources exist.
The directive does not define this attribute.
A required attribute is missing or blank (alt, title, caption, description, slot, lang, mode).
An attribute may appear once.
The value is outside the allowed set or lexical profile (mode: search|generate; voice: female|male; lang: BCP 47 profile of native-v1).
Attributes are {key="value" ...} with double-quoted values; escape \" and \\ only.
The directive needs its body: text after the brace (audio, image, video), a pipe table (table), a fenced source (mermaid) or [n] URL lines (sources).
Text after the brace is allowed only for ::audio, ::image and ::video.
An attribute or body exceeds the native-v1 bound (alt 4096, title/caption 1024, description 8192, transcript and mermaid source 16384, table cell 4096 UTF-16 code units).
A slot key matches [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}.
A slot key is unique in the document and among the slots outside an edited range.
The capability behind this directive or mode (videoGeneration, imageGeneration) is not enabled for the session.
A table is a header row, a separator row (|---|) with the same cell count, then body rows.
Every column heading must be nonblank.
A table has at most 12 columns.
A table has at most 100 body rows.
Every body row has exactly as many cells as the header.
Every ::sources line is [n] URL where n and the exact URL belong to one result of the session research.
A [[handle]] must be one of the handles given for the edited range; new documents have none.
A handle may be used on one block only.
The link URL is not in the allowlist: the label stays as text and the URL is dropped.
The block with this handle changed type: a new node ID was allocated.
